## Prospective AFTER observation protocol (proposal, not yet activated)

1. Freeze the actual last adopted operational merge SHA, resulting tree and UTC, workflow and planner blobs, reproducibility and regeneration workflow blobs, relevant host/BDD manifests and normative SPEC identity. Record covered base branches and subsequent configuration changes. No invented activation date or retroactive alteration of frozen BEFORE. A material configuration change ends that configuration's cohort; retain the shorter cohort with its denominator, do not silently pool.
2. Enumerate merged PRs in provider merge-time order (tie-break PR number), beginning strictly after activation for the corresponding branch/configuration; collect first 50 eligible ordinary merges without selecting on success, expense or data availability. Flag program/CI/regeneration-changing PRs separately by reviewed identity and changed-file inventory; report their counts and compute alongside ordinary PRs. Retain all incomplete observations, with flags. If fewer than 50, report actual n and continue prospective collection; do not fabricate or spend hosted compute for a sample. Owner must approve activation/exclusion policy.
3. Report three separate scopes: (a) historical comparable exact-final-head **premerge** workflow cost with the original frozen scope retained; (b) obligation-complete qualification cost including final-head dispatch and deferred exact-tree postmerge Intel/repro/release verification where required (reconstruct BEFORE equivalently or mark noncomparable); (c) full attributable lifecycle including superseded heads, failed/cancelled executions, regeneration/forward/dispatch/recovery and postmerge work. Preserve run ID, attempt, execution origin and PR/composite allocation mapping; deduplicate actual executions and report shared work once in totals, not once per member. Unattributable or unavailable jobs are unknown, not zero; distinguish log spans, allocated seconds and actual billed usage.
4. Report exact-head green fraction with numerator/denominator, separate original historical green definition from obligation-complete green. Premerge time-to-green uses earliest qualifying non-skipped trigger to terminal required success; for non-green, retain time to merge or observation cutoff as a censored duration with reason (merge is a competing event, not a successful green). Report postmerge completion separately. Do not use success-only median as unconditional improvement or compare mismatched obligations.
5. Predeclare release/v0.5 common-support primary comparison (historical n=7); report base and CI-changing strata, sample sizes, descriptive p50/p90/p95 with method and small-n warning, queue vs execution, premerge review/staging vs CI, throughput, failures/retries/retained work, cost and assurance. No causal attribution across changed workloads, toolchains, host mix or queue confounders. Actual billing absent = NOT_AVAILABLE; private-rate model separately labeled. A→B1/B2→C attribution only on comparable controlled evidence; external challenge is a distinct layer.
6. Preserve raw receipts, complete pagination/attempt flags, hashes, collection scope/cutoff and missing-data register. Replay offline and independently challenge before any final claim. Owner may explicitly accept a bounded operational handoff with longitudinal measurement still open in #637; do not equate that with a completed 50-PR AFTER cohort or waive current DOD-10 by inference.
